# Moody Spurgeon MacPherson

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P33](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy. He features a big fat face, small blue eyes, and ears that stick out like flaps.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is preparing to become a minister. He experiences anxiety regarding his academic performance, specifically fearing that he will fail in English history.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)_

## Traits

## History

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson joined the newly formed Queen's preparation class organized by Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. After completing the term and taking a summer vacation, he eventually traveled to town with his peers from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to begin attending classes at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXX.
